meta.title: FAQ
meta.description: Common questions about using AlarmTalk: voices, plans and your account.

items.q: How do I make a voice?
items.a: Record something or upload an audio file. Recordings run from 12 seconds up to 2 minutes. You can register only your own voice, or the voice of someone close, like family or a partner, who has given you permission. Once the voice exists, you can set as many alarms to it as you like. Registering a voice needs the Plus plan, and you can create one per month.

items.q: Does it ring in airplane mode or without internet?
items.a: Yes. Alarms use your phone’s own alarm scheduler and audio that was downloaded ahead of time. It doesn’t check with a server when it rings, so it works in airplane mode, underground, or with no data.

items.q: Do I still get snooze and weekday repeats?
items.a: Yes. Repeat days, snooze length and limit, vibration patterns, alarm sounds and skipping public holidays all work like any alarm app. The only difference is what you hear.

items.q: How many times can I type my own line?
items.a: This counts new audio made from text you write. Free gets 3 a month with the built-in voices, and Plus gets 30 a month, including your registered voice. Each account has one count, and it refills on the 1st of every month, Korea time (KST). Reusing audio you already made doesn’t use a count. If you make the audio and then cancel saving the alarm, that one still counts, and if making it fails, we give it back.

Yes. When you subscribe to Plus for the first time, you get a 1-month free trial. The App Store and Google Play decide who qualifies. When the trial ends, $3.90 a month is charged automatically. If you don’t want that, cancel before the trial ends (on the App Store, at least 24 hours before) in your App Store account settings or Google Play subscriptions. You keep access until the trial period ends even after cancelling.

items.q: Can anyone else use the voice I register?
items.a: No. A voice you register is used only for alarms on your account. There is no way to export the audio as a file, either.

items.q: What happens to my voice if I delete my account?
items.a: It is destroyed on our servers, along with your original recordings and every clip made from that voice.

items.q: Can I redo a voice I’m not happy with?
items.a: You can re-record as many times as you like before you confirm it. After that, you can register one voice per month, and deleting the one you made won’t give you another that month.

items.q: If I cancel, do I lose access right away?
items.a: No. Cancel in the store and you keep everything until the time you already paid for runs out. After that you move to the free plan, and alarms that used your registered voice ring in a built-in voice (Mina). Your registered voice is kept for 3 days and then deleted; subscribe again within that time and the original voice comes back.

items.q: Are there forced missions, like math or photo challenges?
items.a: No. AlarmTalk would rather you opened your eyes because you wanted to hear the voice, not because something forced you.

People who already know whose voice they want to hear every day: parents and children living apart who want to start the morning with each other’s voice, people who miss a partner’s voice, and people who want to wake themselves up in their own voice. With no voice to register, you can start right away with the built-in voices.
It runs on Android 8.0 or later and on iPhone with iOS 26 or later. The Google Play and App Store buttons on this page are where you get it.
